architecture.mechanism: Performance optimization control strategy based on constant speed cruise that adjusts engine throttle and hydraulic pump/motor displacement to maintain optimal efficiency.
architecture.intervention: Implement a real-time control algorithm in the CVT transmission control unit that continuously calculates the required engine power and preset pulley speed ratio to determine the optimal hydraulic pressure and belt clamping force, thereby preventing slippage and power loss during highway cruising.
architecture.expected_effect: Sustained drive power at highway speeds by eliminating belt slippage through optimized hydraulic clamping forces, ensuring the system exceeds the 70,000-mile service life constraint by reducing wear from inefficient operating points.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the modified 2021 Nissan Altima on a dynamometer at constant highway speeds (65 mph) under varying load conditions; if the measured output shaft torque drops below the input torque multiplied by the gear ratio minus friction losses, or if belt slip is detected via speed sensor differential, the mechanism has failed.
